header: Directly querying Amazon CloudWatch Logs data in OpenSearch Service
content:
OpenSearch Service
This section will walk you through the process of creating and conﬁguring a data source integration
in Amazon OpenSearch Service, enabling you to eﬃciently query and analyze your data stored in
CloudWatch Logs.
In the following pages, you'll learn how to set up a CloudWatch Logs direct-query data source,
navigate the necessary prerequisites, and follow step-by-step procedures using the AWS
Management Console.
